chunks.content: SynthDrive RAG Service is a powerful retrieval-augmented generation system designed to enhance AI applications with accurate, contextual information retrieval.

The system combines vector search capabilities with knowledge graph technologies to provide comprehensive and relevant responses to user queries. It features multi-tenant architecture for data isolation, supports various document types, and offers semantic chunking for optimal text processing.

Key features include hybrid retrieval combining vector search and graph-based knowledge retrieval, semantic chunking for meaningful text segmentation, entity extraction and relationship mapping, multi-tenant data isolation, and support for various document types.
